contract: docs/DEPLOYMENT_HARDENING.md (Release Verification and Rollback Runbook); docs/QUALITY_GATES.md
description: What must be true at the exact commit a release tag resolves to before release.yml publishes anything. tools/ci/release_gate.py reads this file and the workflow files at that commit; a lane the workflows define is required unless it is listed under optional_jobs or excluded with a rationale.

excluded.scope: real-device smoke verification of the embedded targets
excluded.rationale: No device lab is attached to CI. The QEMU user-mode lanes (cross + qemu) cover the instruction sets and the embedded matrix covers the builds; a device result would need its own provenance (run id, device id, commit) before it could count, so it is excluded rather than assumed.

excluded.scope: the Nightly workflow (100K fuzz, extended e2e, DSL v2 differential)
excluded.rationale: Scheduled per day, not per commit, so a nightly result cannot be bound to the tagged commit. Release readiness rests on the per-commit CI and Perf Gates runs, which include the Rust-vs-C differential fuzz lane.
